notes: Fixed why another music app would start playing on its own after a phone call or when a headset reconnected: SideCut never asked Android for audio focus, so the system handed playback back to whatever app last held it — even one that was not open. SideCut now holds focus while a song plays
A call pauses your song, and it resumes by itself the moment the call ends — instead of staying silent or handing the speakers to another app
Reconnecting Bluetooth / the car now targets SideCut while it is playing, rather than the last music app Android remembers
Pausing on purpose still releases the speakers cleanly, so another app can take over exactly when you want it to
Duck requests (a navigation prompt, a notification) no longer fight over the volume the crossfade is using
Under the hood: an injected native plugin (SideCutAudioFocus) reports focus changes to the player; nothing changes in the browser version
